Nadia, I found five distinct tickets on Vantorre Group (the parent). All of them are in the sources you can see: this channel, #inc-vtg-hartford, and Moss's Strategic digests.

| Ticket | What it is | Source |
|---|---|---|
| #PD-4418 | Warehouse supervisor reported the `Carrier_Dwell_Summary` export dropping timestamps for Dock Door 9 at the 04:00 shift change. | Moss digest 9/15/2025. It says "the account Nadia runs" and doesn't name Vantorre, so I'm inferring it's the parent. Please confirm. |
| #8841, also written #PD-8841 | Gate kiosk and check-in problems at the plant. The 4/27 digest cites two missed carrier check-ins at Allentown. The 5/4 digest cites a gate kiosk timeout at Door 12. The 9/30 digest cites Dock Door 14 not selectable on the kiosk at Newark. | Moss digests 4/27/2026 (as #PD-8841), 5/4/2026 and 9/30/2026; #strategic-pod, Jul 1 |
| INC-4821 | Screenshot for the status-page access issue during the Hartford kiosk outage on 8/3. | #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3, 11:08 |
| VT-55120 | Root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage. Carrowmere's gateway route finding and the reconnect log are attached. | #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14 |

That is four rows for five tickets: #8841 and #PD-8841 are probably the same ticket, so I listed them together.

**#8841 status.** Gideon said on Jul 1 that he closed it. The 9/30 digest still describes it as an open escalation to platform engineering. The 9/30 description also differs from the earlier ones (Newark and Door 14, versus Allentown and Door 12). It could be a reopened ticket or a mislabelled one, so check it before the steering committee.

**Left out.** #4812 (3/10/2025 digest) is on Vantorre Mobility, so I excluded it. #PD-4402 is Quillfeather, not Vantorre.

**Gaps.** I only looked at the pod channel, #inc-vtg-hartford and the Strategic digests. Tickets raised by email or in the support system won't appear here. Some digests mention Vantorre without a ticket number, such as Mateo's procurement emails, and I didn't count those.
